The '''H1.5 hyperdrive''' was a Class 1 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] unit manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. One of these units was originally installed in the [[Conqueror-class assault ship|''Conqueror''-class assault ship]] ''[[Stinger]]''.
